about: Cues rendered by the engine before an instrument with no effect lost its effects chain, when every cue instrument had one, with the distortion curve centred as #110 centres it. A cue that renders differently from these sounds different from before.
patch: EffectsChain.makeDistortionCurve as #110 has it: 44101 points at x = 2i/(n - 1) - 1, where c3bbbbb has 44100 at x = 2i/n - 1. Nothing else.
how: At c3bbbbb with the patch applied, the reference cases of cues.effects.render.test.ts as #110 has it, run with UPDATE_RENDER_REFERENCE=1: the document loaded into an engine on a 1.5 s mono offline context, then playCue(name, 0.128); samples copied out of the AudioBuffer at once. Without the patch the same run reproduces the references it replaced byte for byte, and with it, two runs are byte-identical.

moved.why: Re-recorded for #110. The document loads grit, a sawtooth with distortion 0.6, beside these cues, and at c3bbbbb its chain is built and sits idle in every render. Its waveshaper read a curve centred half a point off, so with nothing going in it put out -4.5536e-4, about -66.8 dBFS, settled within 2 ms of the first frame and held to the last, and every reference recorded before #110 holds that offset under its cue. With the curve centred, nothing in comes out as nothing.
moved.plain.wav: Moved by +4.5536e-4, within 1e-7, from 2 ms to its last sample, and by up to 4.9587e-4 before that, while the idle chain's oversampler settles. The cue itself did not move: it has no distortion. Every frame before it starts at 128 ms, and every frame after it ends at 358 ms, is now exactly 0.
moved.echo.wav: Moved by +4.5536e-4, within 1e-7, from 2 ms to its last sample, and by up to 4.9587e-4 before that, while the idle chain's oversampler settles. The cue and its echoes did not move: they have no distortion. Every frame before the cue starts at 128 ms is now exactly 0; the echoes ring to the end of the render.
moved.both.wav: Moved by +4.5536e-4, within 1e-7, from 2 ms to its last sample, and by up to 4.9587e-4 before that, while the idle chain's oversampler settles. Neither note moved: neither has distortion. Every frame before the cue starts at 128 ms is now exactly 0; the echoes ring to the end of the render.
